validity.recommendation: No existence/classification/duplicate issue. Status is stale — see status_reviews.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real and independently confirmed. This is GSPL's dedicated spur linking HPCL's new 5 MTPA Chhara LNG regasification terminal (Gir-Somnath district) into GSPL's state gas grid at Lothpur (Amreli district) -- commissioned 20 March 2025, reported independently by Pipeline & Gas Journal, Construction World (India), Indian Masterminds Bureau, and the Palladian trade-press group (World Pipelines/Hydrocarbon Engineering/Tanks & Terminals, one origin/byline 'Emilie Grant'). Contractor Ace Pipeline Contracts Pvt Ltd, awarded Sep-2023. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a gas transmission spur (36-inch, 18 MMSCMD) -- not a gathering/process line. DUPLICATE: checked against all 8 other in-scope rows; no overlap. P3912 (Swan LNG Terminal->Dahej) touches the same general Jafrabad/Amreli corridor but is a physically distinct line (Swan Energy's own private LNG terminal at Jafrabad, not HPCL's Chhara terminal) -- not a duplicate. CAVEAT: the sheet's own Status [ref] (two PNGRB data-bank.html anchors) fails a content check for 'construction' and, per this project's own register_crosswalk.json, this line is classified ABSENT_DEDICATED_OR_TIE_IN (register: null) -- it is a dedicated tie-in outside PNGRB's common-carrier authorisation list, so those two anchor links likely do not actually document this specific spur. The wiki's own citations are equally weak: a generic March-2022 network map (doesn't name this pipeline) and an environmentclearance.nic.in Form A link that currently 503s. None of this puts existence in doubt -- independent, dated, named trade-press coverage of the commissioning is unambiguous -- but the sheet's citation trail for Status predates and does not actually support even the OLD 'construction' value, let alone track the March-2025 commissioning.

validity.recommendation: Correct EndPrefecture/District from 'Lonhtpur' to 'Amreli' (Lothpur is a village/CNG station within Amreli district, Jafrabad taluka -- it is not itself a district). Fill the currently-blank EndLocation with 'Lothpur'. Also consider renaming the pipeline entity: every independent source spells the destination 'Lothpur', not 'Lonhtpur'/'Lonhtapur'.
validity.researcher_notes: All four independently-verified sources (Pipeline & Gas Journal, Construction World, Indian Masterminds, World Pipelines) describe the route identically as 'HPCL LNG terminal at Chhara in Gir-Somnath district to Lothpur in Amreli district.' Two Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (morth.gov.in) right-of-way notices for this exact carrier pipe ('36" Dia Carrier Pipe... from GSPL's Lothpur CNG Station in Village-Lothpur, Taluka-Jafrabad, District-Amreli to Chhara LNG Terminal... District-Gir Somnath') corroborate the same place hierarchy but could not be cleared through url_verifier.py (their content is JS-rendered and returns only a bare ministry header to both the verifier and WebFetch) -- so I am not citing morth.gov.in directly, only using it as informal triangulation; the four verified trade-press sources alone already give >=2 independent, named confirmations that the district is Amreli and the place is 'Lothpur', not 'Lonhtpur'. The sheet currently stores 'Lonhtpur' in EndPrefecture/District (a district-level field) and leaves EndLocation blank -- both wrong for the field they're in.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Three separately-bylined outlets (Pipeline & Gas Journal / P&GJ staff, Construction World's 'CW Team', Indian Masterminds Bureau -- distinct from the fourth cluster of Palladian-group reprints sharing byline 'Emilie Grant') all independently report GSPL commissioned this exact pipeline (Chhara HPCL LNG terminal, Gir-Somnath -> Lothpur, Amreli; 36-inch; 18 MMSCMD; contractor Ace Pipeline) on 20 March 2025 -- five months before the sheet's own 2025-07-17 LastUpdated, so the 'construction' value was already stale on the date it was last touched. Status -> operating; StartYear1 -> 2025 (commissioning date, not an authorisation date -- no PNGRB authorisation date is available/relevant here since the crosswalk shows this line sits outside the common-carrier register as a dedicated tie-in). This is a single commissioning event (dispatch + receiving terminals both came up together per the sourcing), not a phased/partial commissioning, so no split row is warranted.

fills.researcher_notes: Sheet's existing Capacity value (18.00 MMSCMD) matches every independent commissioning report exactly; the cluster simply had no ref. Confirmed, not changed.

Diameter/DiameterUnits were genuinely blank (Diameter is the known gap for this country). 36-inch is stated identically by three separately-authored/bylined outlets plus, informally, by two morth.gov.in right-of-way notice titles referencing the same '36" Dia Carrier Pipe' for this exact GSPL Lothpur-Chhara crossing (not cited directly -- content not retrievable through url_verifier.py, JS-rendered page).

EndLocation was blank; the Location [ref] cluster had no ref at all despite StartLocation/EndPrefecture-District already carrying values. Only proposing the blank EndLocation field here -- EndPrefecture/District currently holds 'Lonhtpur', which is wrong (should be 'Amreli'); that is an existing value, not a blank, so it is flagged as a validity/attribution concern above rather than force-corrected in a fill.

Every independent source names GSPL as sole developer/owner of the pipeline (distinct from HPCL LNG Ltd, which owns/operates only the regasification terminal at the Chhara end, and Ace Pipeline Contracts, the EPC contractor). Confirms the sheet's existing 100% GSPL ownership; owner cluster simply had no ref.

Could not independently pin the sheet's 85.00 km to a verified, citable current source. Every 2025 commissioning report omits a length figure. The only length figures found come from GSPL's original 2018 EOI/proposal stage (86.61 km, ~Rs 622 cr, per a search-engine summary of PETROWATCH coverage of the initial PNGRB authorisation problems) -- petrowatch.com itself returned HTTP 403 and could not be verified, and the underlying pngrb.gov.in EOI PDF (already cited on this row as the Route [ref]) is a scanned image with no extractable text. 85 km vs. 86.61 km is a ~2% gap plausibly explained by final-design refinement between the 2018 proposal and the as-built line, not evidence the sheet is wrong -- leaving this UNRESOLVED rather than either confirming or changing the value.

summary: P3910 (Chhara-Lothpur, GSPL) is real and correctly classified -- confirmed independently commissioned/operating since 20 March 2025 (P&GJ, Construction World, Indian Masterminds; PNGRB register-absent because it's a dedicated LNG-terminal tie-in, not a common-carrier line) -- but the sheet's Status was stale at 'construction' through its 2025-07-17 LastUpdated (proposed change to operating/StartYear1=2025), and EndPrefecture/District wrongly holds the place name 'Lonhtpur' where 'Amreli' (the district) belongs, with EndLocation blank where 'Lothpur' belongs. Diameter (36 in), Capacity, and Owner refs filled; Length left UNRESOLVED (85 km sheet vs 86.61 km 2018 proposal, no current verified source).
